protected.role: It is the only enforcer of path parity between .skilled/ and .opencode/.
It keeps the job that runs repository code at contents: read and gives the write token only to the job that runs gh and git.
It checks the dispatch rules that other workflows and tools assume.
It checks the naming rules that other workflows and tools assume.
It holds the only status context the branch ruleset requires.
